```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(rlang)
```

```{r}
# 1.1 Read core tables ----------------------------------------------------

bgc       <- read_csv("bgc_class_dataset_clustering.csv")
antismash <- read.csv("antismash_names.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
metadata  <- read_csv("Metadata_combined.csv")

# 1.2 Add clean node ids and merge with antismash ------------------------

bgc_with_node <- bgc %>%
mutate(
node_clean = str_remove(orig_filename, "\\.region.*$")
)

merged <- bgc_with_node %>%
left_join(antismash, by = c("node_clean" = "node"))

# 1.3 Long metadata: map Sample_Name / Other_Name -> file ----------------

metadata_long <- metadata %>%
select(Sample_Name, Other_Name, everything()) %>%
pivot_longer(
cols = c(Sample_Name, Other_Name),
names_to = "name_type",
values_to = "file"
) %>%
filter(!is.na(file), file != "") %>%
distinct(file, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 1.4 Merge metadata onto BGC table --------------------------------------

df_1 <- merged %>%
left_join(metadata_long, by = "file")

# 1.5 Split rows with missing vs non-missing cb-broad-desc ---------------

nadf <- df_1 %>% filter(is.na(`cb-broad-desc`))   # rows without broad env
df   <- df_1 %>% filter(!is.na(`cb-broad-desc`))  # analysis subset

# At this point we assume df has at least:

# - dataset_name

# - subclass_name

# - cb-broad-desc (broad environment descriptor)

```
```{r}
# KL(p || q) for probability vectors p, q --------------------------------

kl_div <- function(p, q) {
idx <- p > 0 & q > 0
sum(p[idx] * log(p[idx] / q[idx]))
}

```


```{r}
compute_location_uniqueness <- function(df,
location_var = "dataset_name",
subclass_var = "subclass_name",
pseudocount  = 0.5) {
loc_sym <- rlang::sym(location_var)
sub_sym <- rlang::sym(subclass_var)

# 3.1 Count matrix: location × subclass --------------------------------

counts_df <- df %>%
count(!!loc_sym, !!sub_sym, name = "count")

mat_df <- counts_df %>%
tidyr::pivot_wider(
names_from  = !!sub_sym,
values_from = count,
values_fill = 0
)

loc_ids   <- mat_df[[location_var]]
count_mat <- as.matrix(mat_df[, -1, drop = FALSE])
rownames(count_mat) <- loc_ids

K   <- ncol(count_mat)
N_i <- rowSums(count_mat)

# 3.2 Global background θ (smoothed) -----------------------------------

col_tot <- colSums(count_mat) + pseudocount
theta   <- col_tot / sum(col_tot)

# 3.3 Per-location composition φ_i (smoothed) --------------------------

smoothed <- count_mat + pseudocount
phi_mat  <- sweep(smoothed, 1, rowSums(smoothed), "/")

# 3.4 Uniqueness effect size: KL(φ_i || θ) -----------------------------

kl_vec <- apply(phi_mat, 1, function(phi) kl_div(phi, theta))

# 3.5 Likelihood-ratio (G) statistic ----------------------------------

G_vec  <- 2 * N_i * kl_vec
df_chi <- K - 1
p_vec  <- pchisq(G_vec, df = df_chi, lower.tail = FALSE)

out <- tibble(
!!location_var := rownames(count_mat),
total_bgc      = N_i,
KL_divergence  = kl_vec,
G_stat         = G_vec,
df             = df_chi,
p_value        = p_vec,
uniqueness_score = -log10(p_vec)
)

# Attach useful objects as attributes for reuse ------------------------

attr(out, "theta_global")    <- theta
attr(out, "phi_by_location") <- phi_mat
attr(out, "count_mat")       <- count_mat

out
}

```

```{r}
uniq_dataset <- compute_location_uniqueness(
df,
location_var = "dataset_name",
subclass_var = "subclass_name",
pseudocount  = 0.5
)

uniq_dataset %>%
arrange(desc(KL_divergence)) %>%
head(10)

```


```{r}
# Frequentist uniqueness per dataset

uniq_dataset <- compute_location_uniqueness(
df,
location_var = "dataset_name",
subclass_var = "subclass_name",
pseudocount  = 0.5
)

uniq_dataset %>% arrange(desc(KL_divergence)) %>% head(10)
```

```{r}
compute_location_uniqueness_bayes <- function(df,
location_var   = "dataset_name",
subclass_var   = "subclass_name",
pseudocount    = 0.5,
alpha_strength = 1,   # total prior mass α0
n_draws        = 2000,
seed           = 1) {
set.seed(seed)

# 4.1 Base frequentist uniqueness --------------------------------------

base_res <- compute_location_uniqueness(
df,
location_var = location_var,
subclass_var = subclass_var,
pseudocount  = pseudocount
)

# Extract pieces

count_mat <- attr(base_res, "count_mat")
theta     <- attr(base_res, "theta_global")

loc_ids <- rownames(count_mat)
K       <- ncol(count_mat)
N_i     <- rowSums(count_mat)

# 4.2 Dirichlet prior α centered on θ (empirical Bayes) ----------------

alpha0 <- alpha_strength
eps    <- 1e-12
alpha  <- pmax(alpha0 * theta, eps)

# 4.3 Posterior parameters α + n_ij ------------------------------------

post_alpha_mat <- sweep(count_mat, 2, alpha, "+")  # locations × subclasses
post_sum       <- rowSums(post_alpha_mat)

# Posterior mean and variance of φ_ij under Dirichlet ------------------

post_mean <- post_alpha_mat / post_sum

post_var <- post_alpha_mat * (post_sum - post_alpha_mat) /
(post_sum^2 * (post_sum + 1))

# 4.4 Helper: Draw from Dirichlet --------------------------------------

rdirichlet_mat <- function(n, alpha_vec) {
m <- matrix(
rgamma(n * length(alpha_vec), shape = alpha_vec, rate = 1),
nrow = n, byrow = TRUE
)
m / rowSums(m)
}

n_loc          <- nrow(count_mat)
subclass_names <- colnames(count_mat)

U_mean <- numeric(n_loc)
U_lo   <- numeric(n_loc)
U_hi   <- numeric(n_loc)

phi_lo      <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_loc, ncol = K)
phi_hi      <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_loc, ncol = K)
enrich_prob <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_loc, ncol = K)

# 4.5 Posterior sampling per location ----------------------------------

for (i in seq_len(n_loc)) {
a_i <- post_alpha_mat[i, ]
# draws_i: n_draws × K
draws_i <- rdirichlet_mat(n_draws, a_i)

# Uniqueness draws: U_i^(s) = KL(φ_i^(s) || θ)
U_draws_i <- apply(draws_i, 1, function(phi) kl_div(phi, theta))

U_mean[i] <- mean(U_draws_i)
U_lo[i]   <- quantile(U_draws_i, 0.025)
U_hi[i]   <- quantile(U_draws_i, 0.975)

# Subclass credible intervals
phi_lo[i, ] <- apply(draws_i, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025)
phi_hi[i, ] <- apply(draws_i, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975)

# Enrichment probability vs global θ_j
enrich_prob[i, ] <- colMeans(draws_i > rep(theta, each = n_draws))

}

# 4.6 Dataset-level Bayesian uniqueness summary ------------------------

loc_col <- rlang::sym(location_var)

uniq_bayes <- tibble(
!!loc_col      := loc_ids,
total_bgc      = N_i,
KL_divergence  = base_res$KL_divergence,   # empirical KL
U_post_mean    = U_mean,
U_post_lo95    = U_lo,
U_post_hi95    = U_hi
)

# 4.7 Subclass-level posterior with uncertainty ------------------------

subclass_post_long <- as.data.frame(post_mean)
colnames(subclass_post_long) <- subclass_names
subclass_post_long[[location_var]] <- loc_ids

subclass_post_long <- subclass_post_long %>%
tidyr::pivot_longer(
cols      = all_of(subclass_names),
names_to  = "subclass_name",
values_to = "post_mean"
) %>%
mutate(
post_sd  = as.vector(sqrt(post_var)),
lo95     = as.vector(phi_lo),
hi95     = as.vector(phi_hi),
enrich_prob = as.vector(enrich_prob),
theta_global = rep(theta, each = n_loc),
credibly_enriched = enrich_prob > 0.95
)

list(
base_uniqueness   = base_res,          # frequentist table
bayes_uniqueness  = uniq_bayes,        # posterior KL summary
subclass_posterior = subclass_post_long,
theta_global      = theta,
count_matrix      = count_mat
)
}

```


```{r}
res_bayes <- compute_location_uniqueness_bayes(
df,
location_var   = "dataset_name",
subclass_var   = "subclass_name",
pseudocount    = 0.5,
alpha_strength = 1,     # tweak for more/less shrinkage
n_draws        = 2000,
seed           = 1
)

# Frequentist table

head(res_bayes$base_uniqueness)

# Posterior uniqueness (mean and 95% CI)

head(res_bayes$bayes_uniqueness)
```

```{r}
res_bayes$subclass_posterior %>%
filter(dataset_name == "Gowanus", credibly_enriched) %>%
arrange(desc(enrich_prob)) %>%
head(20)
```

```{r}
compute_uniqueness_decomposition <- function(uniq_res) {
phi_mat <- attr(uniq_res, "phi_by_location")
theta   <- attr(uniq_res, "theta_global")

# Ensure θ is aligned with columns of φ

theta <- theta[colnames(phi_mat)]

# Contribution matrix: C_ij = φ_ij * log(φ_ij / θ_j)

C_mat <- sweep(
phi_mat,
2,
theta,
FUN = function(phi, th) {
ifelse(phi > 0 & th > 0, phi * log(phi / th), 0)
}
)

drivers_tbl <- as.data.frame(C_mat) %>%
rownames_to_column("dataset_name") %>%
pivot_longer(
cols      = -dataset_name,
names_to  = "subclass_name",
values_to = "KL_contribution"
) %>%
group_by(dataset_name) %>%
mutate(
total_KL         = sum(KL_contribution),
rel_contribution = KL_contribution / total_KL
) %>%
arrange(desc(KL_contribution), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
ungroup()

list(
C_mat   = C_mat,
drivers = drivers_tbl
)
}

```

```{r}
decomp <- compute_uniqueness_decomposition(uniq_dataset)

C_mat       <- decomp$C_mat
drivers_tbl <- decomp$drivers

# Top subclass drivers for Gowanus (by absolute KL contribution)

dataset_of_interest <- "Gowanus"

drivers_gowanus <- drivers_tbl %>%
filter(dataset_name == dataset_of_interest) %>%
arrange(desc(KL_contribution)) %>%
head(10)

drivers_gowanus

```
